qualifier: interferon-alpha effector arm (OAS, IP-10) rather than IRF3-driven interferon induction
name: Cellular antiviral response with interferon-alpha effector induction
rationale: All members describe the cell-intrinsic antiviral response from DNA sensing to interferon-alpha-induced effectors such as OAS and IP-10, whereas confusables centre on IRF3-mediated type I interferon induction, RIG-I/MDA5 or negative cGAS-STING regulation.

qualifier: presynaptic control of glutamate/GABA release and kainate receptors
name: Presynaptic modulation of glutamate and GABA release, kainate receptors
rationale: Members cover presynaptic calcium, vesicle exocytosis, glutamate/GABA secretion, kainate/AMPA receptor activation and short-term plasticity, whereas confusables focus on postsynaptic receptor clustering, diffusion trapping or inhibitory synapse assembly.

qualifier: positive regulation of polymerization at the leading edge
name: Actin polymerization-driven leading-edge protrusion in cell migration
rationale: All members promote actin polymerization and lamellipodium/pseudopodium extension at the leading edge of migrating cells, whereas confusables concern actin severing/depolymerization, negative regulation of migration or Arp2/3-WAVE nucleation.

qualifier: megakaryocyte, erythroid and granulocyte fate choice
name: Myeloid progenitor lineage decisions toward megakaryocyte, erythroid and granulocyte fates
rationale: Members describe progenitor-level commitment and its transcriptional control (RUNX1, VENTX, GM-CSF) across megakaryocyte, erythroid, granulocyte and monocyte fates, whereas confusables emphasise stem cell homeostasis, terminal red cell maturation or RUNX targets in lymphoid and cytokine programmes.

qualifier: oxidative and hypoxic stress
name: Regulation of oxidative and hypoxic stress-induced intrinsic apoptosis
rationale: Members regulate cell death triggered by hydrogen peroxide, hypoxia and oxygen-glucose deprivation via mitochondrial depolarization, distinguishing them from confusables about ferroptosis, MOMP machinery or respiratory chain regulation.

qualifier: BRCA1/BRCA2/PALB2 loss-of-function defects
name: Resection-dependent double-strand break repair and BRCA1/BRCA2/PALB2 defects
rationale: All members involve end resection and the homology-directed or microhomology repair it enables (HR, SSA, MMEJ, D-loop resolution) plus its BRCA1/BRCA2/PALB2 defects, whereas confusables cover classical NHEJ, break sensing, PARylation or Fanconi anemia repair.

core: HDL assembly and reverse cholesterol transport
qualifier: ABCA1-apoA-I-mediated nascent particle formation
name: ABCA1-apoA-I-mediated nascent HDL assembly and reverse cholesterol transport
rationale: Members concern ABCA1/apoA-I-dependent HDL particle formation, Tangier disease, cholesterol efflux and HDL clearance, whereas confusables emphasise LXR-driven efflux regulation, foam cells or HDL/LDL remodeling.

qualifier: osteoclast-mediated remodeling and odontogenesis
name: Bone and dental tissue mineralization and osteoclast remodeling
rationale: Members span bone, dentin, enamel and cementum mineralization with osteoclast differentiation/resorption and mineral-regulating signals (PTH, FGF23-Klotho), whereas confusables centre on IGF responses or sodium-phosphate transport.

qualifier: betaKlotho-dependent, FRS2 and SHC adaptor branches
name: BetaKlotho-dependent FGFR4 signaling through FRS2 and SHC adaptors
rationale: All three members are FGFR4 signaling via betaKlotho ligand binding and FRS/SHC adaptor cascades, whereas confusables concern other FGFR isoforms or PLC/PI3K branches.

qualifier: p53-regulated, from BH3-only activation through apoptosome to execution
name: p53-regulated mitochondrial apoptosis from BH3-only activation to execution
rationale: Members trace p53-controlled intrinsic apoptosis through BH3-only proteins, BAX/BAK, cytochrome c release, apoptosome, SMAC and execution-phase DNA fragmentation, whereas confusables cover senescence, extrinsic death-receptor and necroptotic death or p53 cell cycle arrest.

qualifier: complex assembly and mitochondrial translation elongation rather than electron transport
name: Respiratory chain complex assembly and mitochondrial translation elongation
rationale: Members are assembly of complexes I, III, IV and ATP synthase, inner-membrane protein insertion and mitochondrial translation elongation, whereas confusables describe electron transport and ATP synthesis themselves or translation initiation/termination.

core: Membrane traffic to the plasma membrane
qualifier: endocytic recycling and post-Golgi delivery
name: Endocytic recycling and post-Golgi delivery to the plasma membrane
rationale: Members promote endosome-to-plasma membrane recycling, receptor recycling and Golgi-to-plasma membrane transport, whereas confusables concern retrograde endosome-to-Golgi traffic, Golgi retention or Rab/ARF regulation.

qualifier: SLC4/SLC26 anion exchangers, cation-chloride cotransporters and NHEs with disease defects
name: Inherited defects of chloride, bicarbonate and sodium-coupled ion transporters
rationale: Members are chloride, bicarbonate and other anion exchangers, cation-chloride cotransporters, NHEs and CFTR with their inherited disorders, whereas confusables involve aquaporins, osmotic responses or carbonic anhydrase pH control.

qualifier: P-type sodium-potassium pump and glycoside sensitivity
name: Sodium-potassium pump maintenance of transmembrane electrochemical gradient
rationale: Members describe P-type ATPase sodium/potassium homeostasis and the electrochemical gradient, including cardiac glycoside response, whereas confusables concern V-ATPase acidification, Na+/H+ exchange or magnesium and renal sodium transport.

qualifier: BAF complex variants and CHD/NuRD remodelers
name: BAF and CHD-family ATP-dependent chromatin remodeling complexes
rationale: Most members are formation of BAF complex variants and CHD subfamily/NuRD remodelers (with stem cell maintenance), whereas confusables concern histone acetylation, nucleosome assembly or ChAHP.

qualifier: perivascular stroma, endothelium and IL-33 alarmin signaling
name: Perivascular stroma and endothelium with IL-33 alarmin signaling
rationale: Members are fibroblast, perivascular stromal and endothelial signatures with IL-33 signaling, chemotaxis and adhesion, whereas confusables emphasise ECM/EMT, TGF-beta1 production, fibroblast proliferation or KRAS targets.

qualifier: thymic selection and thymocyte fate
name: Thymic T cell development, selection and early T cell activation
rationale: Members cover thymocyte selection, proliferation, apoptosis, migration and lineage (CD8, gamma-delta, Treg) together with T cell activation modules, whereas confusables focus on proximal TCR/CD28 signaling or Tfh and germinal center B cell programmes.

qualifier: galactose (Leloir), fructose and glycerol with inborn errors
name: Galactose, fructose and glycerol metabolism and their inborn errors
rationale: Members are Leloir galactose and fructose catabolism with their inherited defects plus glycerol/alditol metabolism, whereas confusables cover disaccharide digestion, pentose/xylulose metabolism, glycolysis/glycogen or the pentose phosphate shunt.

qualifier: fission-fusion balance and protein localization to mitochondria
name: Regulation of mitochondrial fission-fusion and protein localization to mitochondria
rationale: Members regulate mitochondrial fission, fusion, fragmentation, membrane potential and protein localization to mitochondria, whereas confusables concern MOMP-driven apoptosis, PINK1-Parkin mitophagy or the core import and cristae machinery.

qualifier: sympathoadrenal tissue development
name: Sympathoadrenal development and norepinephrine-epinephrine biosynthesis
rationale: Members combine norepinephrine/epinephrine synthesis with development of adrenal gland, sympathetic ganglia and noradrenergic neurons, whereas confusables concern enteric neural crest, monoamine degradation, serotonin or neuroblast proliferation.

qualifier: pyruvate dehydrogenase entry and coenzyme A synthesis feeding the TCA cycle
name: Pyruvate dehydrogenase entry, coenzyme A synthesis and TCA cycle
rationale: Members cover pyruvate decarboxylation by PDH, pantothenate/CoA biosynthesis and TCA cycle intermediates, whereas confusables emphasise Fe-S cluster assembly, OGDH/lipoylation or malate-aspartate shuttle transport.

qualifier: male, spermatogenic context
name: Male meiotic recombination and synapsis in spermatogenesis
rationale: Members are meiotic DSB formation, synapsis and recombination in male meiosis I plus spermatogenic structures (manchette, Sertoli barrier), whereas confusables cover oocyte/zygote programmes, gonadal hormones or sperm motility and fertilization.

qualifier: germinal center, memory and plasma cell states
name: B cell germinal center, memory and plasma cell differentiation
rationale: Members are B cell identity signatures and germinal center, memory and plasma cell differentiation with Tfh/ICOS help, whereas confusables cover T cell development, proximal BCR signaling or extrathymic T cells.

qualifier: IL-15/IL-21 NK cell expansion and NF-kB inflammatory output
name: IL-15/IL-21-driven NK cell expansion and NF-kB inflammatory cytokine activation
rationale: Members combine IL-15/IL-21 signaling and NK cell differentiation with NF-kB-driven myeloid activation and TNF/IL-23 output, whereas confusables centre on IL-10/IL-12 family, IL-2/IL-7 or type 2 and mast cell cytokine programmes.

qualifier: proximal antigen receptor signaling and its positive/negative tuning
name: B cell antigen receptor signaling and B cell activation thresholds
rationale: Members cover BCR signaling (second messengers, BTK, RAS, CD22) with B cell development and positive and negative regulators of activation, whereas confusables emphasise B cell surface/plasma signatures, T cell activation or Fc receptor signaling.
